answer: Anyone running 116 aliases hence needs 72 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in pulse, expire in ember, and terrace lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2852 identities would post 1891 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
